animal.label: A Slay Animal weapon against an animal
animal.explanation: A level thirty-one warrior wields a Broad Sword carrying the animals slay, with a lit torch in the later light slot, and faces an adjacent white harpy. The original assigns the slay traits per equipment slot instead of accumulating them, so the weaponless light slot erases the weapon slays: the Borg values the thrust as if the weapon slew nothing. The correction accumulates slays across slots and the weapon counts.
